description:
Current weather and the forecast (up to 9 days) for any city, address or coordinates worldwide: temperature, conditions, rain, wind, humidity, UV index, plus the next 12 hours hour by hour.
Use when: someone asks about the weather, a forecast, rain, temperature or wind somewhere, today, tomorrow or this week.
Example: {"location":"Paris","days":3}
Data: MET Norway (CC BY 4.0), place names via OpenStreetMap. Free, no API key.

days.description: Number of days of daily forecast (1 = today only)

lang.description: Language of the place name: en, fr, nl, de, es… Default: en

lat.description: Optional latitude: if lat and lon are given, they are used instead of geocoding location

location.description: City, address or landmark in any language (e.g. "Paris", "Bruxelles", "Shibuya, Tokyo"), or coordinates as "lat,lon" (e.g. "48.85,2.35")

units.description: metric = °C, km/h, mm; imperial = °F, mph, inches

name: weather_forecast
title: Weather now and forecast for any place
